== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-ig88-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[IG-88]]: The game text changes: “any starship” becomes “anything”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•IG-88” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
